notes.title: Update v2.1.0 Changelog!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! Hope y'all doing great.

Introducing changes:

 Improved optimization around clicks functionality. Now you can easily use macros or 3rd party software for +4hs without the game getting into "Not responding" state.
 Several UI Improvements, like new buttons to access features like directly "sell" an item from the inventory item details view, new button icons, effects over the game.
 "Cash" sound now playing when a new drop comes in (with the confetti explosion).
 Join Discord button added to the main scene!

----
Now we will be focused on a big update where steam achievements will come in, workshop additions, and MORE!.
Stay tuned!

See you around on our Discord!
https://discord.gg/8uQkmJx4Fy

neo.
